ui.prompt: How are you feeling? Spin to explore, tap to choose.

scared.label: Scared
scared.definition: A sudden feeling that you are in danger or about to be hurt.

helpless.label: Helpless
helpless.definition: Feeling that you can't do anything to change what is happening to you.

frightened.label: Frightened
frightened.definition: Strongly afraid, often because of something sudden or threatening.

anxious.label: Anxious
anxious.definition: Worried and uneasy about something that might happen, often without knowing exactly what.

overwhelmed.label: Overwhelmed
overwhelmed.definition: Feeling like there is too much to handle at once, more than you have room for.

worried.label: Worried
worried.definition: Thinking again and again about something that could go wrong.

insecure.label: Insecure
insecure.definition: Unsure of yourself or your place, and doubting that you are good enough.

inadequate.label: Inadequate
inadequate.definition: Feeling that you are not good enough or not able to do what is needed.

inferior.label: Inferior
inferior.definition: Feeling lower or less worthy than other people.

weak.label: Weak
weak.definition: Feeling that you lack the strength, power, or will to cope.

worthless.label: Worthless
worthless.definition: Feeling that you have no value or that you don't matter.

insignificant.label: Insignificant
insignificant.definition: Feeling small and unimportant, as if no one would notice you.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.definition: Feeling pushed away or not wanted by someone.

excluded.label: Excluded
excluded.definition: Feeling left out, as if you are on the outside of a group.

persecuted.label: Persecuted
persecuted.definition: Feeling that you are being targeted or treated badly on purpose.

threatened.label: Threatened
threatened.definition: Sensing that someone or something might harm you or what you care about.

nervous.label: Nervous
nervous.definition: Jittery and on edge about something coming up.

exposed.label: Exposed
exposed.definition: Feeling seen in a way you didn't choose, with nowhere to hide.

fearful.label: Fearful
fearful.definition: Sensing danger or that something bad might happen, and wanting to protect yourself.

let-down.label: Let Down
let-down.definition: Disappointed because someone didn't do what you hoped or expected.

betrayed.label: Betrayed
betrayed.definition: Hurt and angry because someone you trusted broke that trust.

resentful.label: Resentful
resentful.definition: Holding on to anger about being treated unfairly in the past.

humiliated.label: Humiliated
humiliated.definition: Deeply embarrassed and made to feel small, often in front of others.

disrespected.label: Disrespected
disrespected.definition: Feeling that someone treated you as if you didn't matter.

bitter.label: Bitter
bitter.definition: Lasting anger and hurt about something that felt unfair.

indignant.label: Indignant
indignant.definition: Angry about something you see as unjust or insulting.

violated.label: Violated
violated.definition: Feeling that a boundary was crossed or something of yours was taken without permission.

furious.label: Furious
furious.definition: Extremely angry, close to losing control.

jealous.label: Jealous
jealous.definition: Afraid of losing someone or something to another person, or wanting what they have.

aggressive.label: Aggressive
aggressive.definition: Ready to attack or confront, in words or actions.

provoked.label: Provoked
provoked.definition: Stirred up to anger by something someone said or did.

hostile.label: Hostile
hostile.definition: Unfriendly and ready to fight or oppose.

frustrated.label: Frustrated
frustrated.definition: Upset because something keeps getting in your way.

infuriated.label: Infuriated
infuriated.definition: Made extremely angry, usually by something that keeps happening.

annoyed.label: Annoyed
annoyed.definition: Mildly irritated by something that bothers you.

distant.label: Distant
distant.definition: Pulled back from others, keeping feelings at arm's length.

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.definition: Pulling into yourself and avoiding contact with others.

numb.label: Numb
numb.definition: Feeling very little, as if your emotions have been switched off.

critical.label: Critical
critical.definition: Quick to notice faults and judge them.

skeptical.label: Skeptical
skeptical.definition: Doubting whether something is true or can be trusted.

dismissive.label: Dismissive
dismissive.definition: Brushing something off as not worth your attention.

angry.label: Angry
angry.definition: A strong feeling that something is wrong or unfair, with an urge to push back.

disapproving.label: Disapproving
disapproving.definition: Feeling that something is wrong or not okay.

judgmental.label: Judgmental
judgmental.definition: Forming harsh opinions about someone or something.

embarrassed.label: Embarrassed
embarrassed.definition: Self-conscious and uncomfortable after something awkward or revealing.

disappointed.label: Disappointed
disappointed.definition: Sad that something didn't turn out the way you hoped.

appalled.label: Appalled
appalled.definition: Shocked and disgusted by something you think is very wrong.

revolted.label: Revolted
revolted.definition: Strongly repelled, with an urge to get away.

awful.label: Awful
awful.definition: Feeling very bad, sick, or unpleasant inside.

nauseated.label: Nauseated
nauseated.definition: Sick to your stomach, as if you might throw up.

detestable.label: Detestable
detestable.definition: Feeling that something, or you yourself, is hateful or deeply unpleasant.

repelled.label: Repelled
repelled.definition: Pushed away by something you find unpleasant.

horrified.label: Horrified
horrified.definition: Filled with shock and fear at something terrible.

hesitant.label: Hesitant
hesitant.definition: Holding back because you are unsure or uneasy.

disgusted.label: Disgusted
disgusted.definition: Strong dislike of something that feels gross, wrong, or offensive.

hurt.label: Hurt
hurt.definition: Emotional pain from something said, done, or lost.

depressed.label: Depressed
depressed.definition: Low and heavy for a long time, with little energy or hope.

empty.label: Empty
empty.definition: Feeling hollow, as if something important is missing.

guilty.label: Guilty
guilty.definition: Feeling that you did something wrong and wanting to make it right.

remorseful.label: Remorseful
remorseful.definition: Deeply sorry for something you did.

ashamed.label: Ashamed
ashamed.definition: Feeling that something is wrong with who you are, not just with what you did.

despair.label: Despair
despair.definition: Losing all hope that things can get better.

powerless.label: Powerless
powerless.definition: Feeling unable to affect what happens to you.

grief.label: Grief
grief.definition: Deep sorrow after losing someone or something you love.

vulnerable.label: Vulnerable
vulnerable.definition: Open to being hurt, without your usual protection.

fragile.label: Fragile
fragile.definition: Feeling easily broken, as if you can't take much more.

victimized.label: Victimized
victimized.definition: Feeling that you were harmed or treated unfairly by others.

lonely.label: Lonely
lonely.definition: Wanting connection and feeling alone without it.

abandoned.label: Abandoned
abandoned.definition: Feeling left behind by someone you counted on.

sad.label: Sad
sad.definition: A heavy feeling of loss, disappointment, or hurt.

optimistic.label: Optimistic
optimistic.definition: Expecting that things will turn out well.

inspired.label: Inspired
inspired.definition: Moved to create, act, or do something meaningful.

hopeful.label: Hopeful
hopeful.definition: Believing that something good can happen.

trusting.label: Trusting
trusting.definition: Feeling safe relying on someone or something.

intimate.label: Intimate
intimate.definition: Feeling close and deeply connected to someone.

sensitive.label: Sensitive
sensitive.definition: Easily moved, and keenly aware of your own feelings and other people's.

peaceful.label: Peaceful
peaceful.definition: Calm and settled, without inner conflict.

thankful.label: Thankful
thankful.definition: Glad and appreciative for something you received.

loving.label: Loving
loving.definition: Feeling deep care and affection for someone.

powerful.label: Powerful
powerful.definition: Feeling strong and able to make things happen.

creative.label: Creative
creative.definition: Full of ideas and wanting to make something new.

courageous.label: Courageous
courageous.definition: Facing fear or difficulty and acting anyway.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.definition: Feeling welcomed and included as you are.

valued.label: Valued
valued.definition: Feeling that others see your worth and appreciate you.

respected.label: Respected
respected.definition: Feeling that others take you seriously and treat you well.

proud.label: Proud
proud.definition: Pleased with something you or someone close to you did.

confident.label: Confident
confident.definition: Sure of yourself and your abilities.

successful.label: Successful
successful.definition: Feeling that you reached a goal or did well.

interested.label: Interested
interested.definition: Wanting to know more about something.

inquisitive.label: Inquisitive
inquisitive.definition: Eager to ask questions and find things out.

curious.label: Curious
curious.definition: Drawn to explore something new or unknown.

content.label: Content
content.definition: Satisfied with how things are right now.

joyful.label: Joyful
joyful.definition: Full of great happiness and delight.

free.label: Free
free.definition: Unburdened and able to be yourself.

playful.label: Playful
playful.definition: In the mood for fun and lightheartedness.

cheeky.label: Cheeky
cheeky.definition: Playfully bold or a little mischievous.

happy.label: Happy
happy.definition: A light, good feeling of pleasure or well-being.

excited.label: Excited
excited.definition: Eager and full of energy about something.

energetic.label: Energetic
energetic.definition: Full of energy and ready to go.

eager.label: Eager
eager.definition: Keen and impatient for something to happen.

awe.label: Awe
awe.definition: Wonder at something vast, beautiful, or powerful.

astonished.label: Astonished
astonished.definition: Greatly surprised, almost unable to believe it.

confused.label: Confused
confused.definition: Unable to make sense of something.

perplexed.label: Perplexed
perplexed.definition: Puzzled by something that doesn't add up.

disillusioned.label: Disillusioned
disillusioned.definition: Let down after learning something isn't as good as you believed.

dismayed.label: Dismayed
dismayed.definition: Upset and discouraged by something unexpected.

shocked.label: Shocked
shocked.definition: Stunned by something sudden and upsetting.

surprised.label: Surprised
surprised.definition: A quick reaction to something unexpected.

tired.label: Tired
tired.definition: Low on energy and needing rest.

unfocused.label: Unfocused
unfocused.definition: Having trouble keeping your attention on one thing.

sleepy.label: Sleepy
sleepy.definition: Ready for sleep, with heavy eyes and a slow body.

out-of-control.label: Out of Control
out-of-control.definition: Feeling that things are happening faster than you can manage.

busy.label: Busy
busy.definition: Occupied with a lot to do.

rushed.label: Rushed
rushed.definition: Hurrying, without enough time to do things well.

pressured.label: Pressured
pressured.definition: Pushed by demands or expectations from others or yourself.

bored.label: Bored
bored.definition: Uninterested and wanting something to happen.

apathetic.label: Apathetic
apathetic.definition: Not caring or feeling much about anything.

indifferent.label: Indifferent
indifferent.definition: Neither for nor against something, without strong feelings either way.

bad.label: Bad
bad.definition: Generally unwell or off, without one clear emotion.
